## What this changes

## Type
- [ ] Map / data  - [ ] Textures  - [ ] Models  - [ ] Landmark / signage  - [ ] Code

## Checked
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Screenshot / clip attached for anything visible (day **and** night if it's a surface)
- [ ] New assets are CC0 / properly licensed and recorded in the matching `LICENSES.md` / `CREDITS.md`
- [ ] No Street View, Mapillary, news or web-found images committed
- [ ] Regenerated data files included, with the exact command used
- [ ] FPS before / after noted if this touches rendering or adds world content
